create_awaitable: create an Await object that calls a specified function with given args when the result is requested
run_awaitable_wait: run _awaitable_wait to request the result of an Await object, calling the function immediately if not yet completed
create_awaitable_nowait: create a completed Await object with a specified result using _awaitable_nowait
register_builtin_awaitable_wait: register _awaitable_wait as a JIT builtin under the prim::awaitable_wait operator
register_builtin_awaitable_nowait: register _awaitable_nowait as a JIT builtin under the prim::awaitable_nowait operator
